title: 額溫儀
question: 紅外線額溫儀會根據額溫讓使用者知道他是否發燒。若額溫高於37度（不含37度），額溫儀會顯示「你發燒了」，否則會顯示「溫度正常」。請撰寫額溫儀程式，輸出並顯示溫度狀況。

test_case.note: 額溫35度，不高於37度，沒有發燒

en.title: Thermometer
en.question: A thermometer checks if you have a fever. If your temperature is more than 37 (not 37), it shows "You have a fever". If not, it shows "Normal". Input the temperature. Output what it shows.

test_case.note: The temperature is 35. It is not more than 37. No fever
